purpose: Compact requirements and proposed new prototype sensitivity design. This is not an executable ledger or proof of a completed case.
required_before_execution: Freeze the final routed/refilled board and re-resolve every pad, part and saved fill against that source.
Bind fresh native all-pad connectivity, physical/process checks, parity, standard/all-track DRC and exact file hashes.
Every tested power/return net must be complete; a power-only screen may separately identify unrelated ordinary opens.
Compile explicit circuit cases with finite contacts and actual return geometry. Preserve grouped native pad unions.
Select numerical grids and convergence margins within an explicitly allocated compute budget.
Recheck all later ordinary drills/antipads before final numerical work. No prior geometry receipt survives a source change.
load_scope: Capacity DSM does not inherit the classic receiver accuracy promise.
USB configuration disconnects external ABC, DSM and servo loads.
CORE aggregate includes CORE-powered bias/control and U11 consumption once.

proposed_case_dimensions.allocation_meaning: New adversarial allocation of the entire electronics allowance at one actual supply/return pair; not measured demand or a historical split.
proposed_case_dimensions.upper_receiver: Unloaded DSM, initial high output factors, ABC disconnected or AB/AC/BC at 12.6 V.
proposed_case_dimensions.dependent_selection: Select weakest relevant baseline allocation, then expand if source/load/sensitivity changes its ranking; no universal cross-product claim.

parts_note: Resolve the final native parts/BOM again before activation. U9 is the buck; U7 is a mux.

voltage_screens.ABC_conditional_harness: 4.5 V remote minimum, 1 A, 0.200 ohm contact loop plus measured cable loop <=0.100 ohm.
voltage_screens.classic_DSM_conditional_harness: 3.135 V remote minimum at 20 mA, 0.120 ohm contact loop plus measured cable loop <=0.100 ohm.
voltage_screens.U9_note: VIN>=VOUT+1 V conditions the nominal 3.3 V PWM accuracy row. Initial accuracy excludes line/load. Staying above 3 V does not establish regulation.
voltage_screens.servo_note: Board-pad screening only. Actual output harness loss, physical temperatures and waveform behavior remain unqualified.

initial_low.classification: Specified initial tolerance and forced-PWM feedback limits; no line/load allowance

initial_high.classification: Specified initial tolerance and forced-PWM feedback limits; no line/load allowance

body105_low.classification: Engineering body-temperature sensitivity; independent adverse 25 ppm/K drift, no ratio tracking

converter_model: Conserve output power using actual local input voltage and eta_total=75/85/95%; 85% modeled baseline. Total loss includes operating consumption; additive converter IQ=0 prevents double counting. No efficiency guarantee.
U8_RON_scope: 90 mOhm maximum through 105 C applies only to stated VINx>=5 V and 200 mA tests; other voltages/load currents use explicit 90/120/150 mOhm sensitivities. Report actual conditions and conditional allowable RON.
additional_regulation_scope: Separate 0/1/2% static output-error sensitivities from manufacturer initial terms. Neither typical line/load rows nor selected sensitivity factors establish guaranteed ripple/regulation bounds.

not_counted_again: U6/U9 operating consumption is already within eta_total; additive converter IQ stays zero.
U11 and CORE-powered bias remain inside the aggregate 0.32/0.30 A electronics allowance.
limits: U5 610 uA is a maximum at 12 V, open OUT, specified control settings; use at other inputs/load states is a modeled screen.
U7 4.4/4.5 uA are selected-input maximum rows through 105 C under their input-priority conditions.
U10 140 uA is the 6.5 V, open OUT, 20 kOhm ILIM row; actual voltage and resistor differ, so application is modeled.
U8 400 uA uses its open-output maximum row. The additional 500 uA covers the published wide-differential inactive-input leakage magnitude as a conservative selected-input demand.
The U8 leakage reserve omits detailed inactive-rail current direction and return distribution; it cannot establish backfeed behavior.
The 20 uA BEC priority reserve bounds the magnitude through 330 kOhm for declared PR1/ST voltages within 0 to 6 V, beyond the 28 kOhm divider already counted. CORE bias is not added again.
The added sensitivity is 2 mA at each of three external device input/return pairs, 6 mA total beyond explicit terms; it is an engineering comparison envelope, not a manufacturer guarantee.

added_auxiliary_slice: Add 2 mA at each of three external device input/return pairs, 6 mA total beyond explicit terms. BEC: U5.5/U5.8, U7.3/U7.1, U8.7/U8.12; USB: U10.4/U10.5, U7.6/U7.1, U8.2/U8.12. Engineering envelope only.

same_BEC_limits: One external BEC source; solve positive and return sharing independently.
Illustrative resistances are not measured factory bounds.
J8 requires unused SBUS and empty signal cavity, with verified polarity/fit.
15.8/15.9 A servo subtotals already exceed 10 A continuous BEC capability. Add newly solved same-state electronics demand for every total-current comparison.
30 A peak has no supplied duration. Approximate plotted current endpoints do not qualify startup, stall, reversal or an operating envelope.

report: Actual local U8 input voltage/current and whether datasheet test conditions apply.
Supremum sampled/bisected RON meeting the declared receiver floors while the constant-regulation model stays within its declared input/headroom domain.
Separate3.0V operating-input-only allowance and4.3V nominal3.3V PWM-accuracy-window allowance.

At each RON solve all copper/returns and constant-power input currents again; do not infer a fixed-current series-drop allowance.
